arabic text: Ghar me khuda ke ye qayamat huwi | Sajda e haq me huwe zakhmi ali\nHaatif e ghaibi ne ye aawaaz di
english translation text: Within God's house this Judgement Day occurred: Ali was wounded\nwhile prostrating to the Truth. An unseen caller announced:

arabic text: Maahe mubarak mein ghazab hogaya\nZakhmi shenshaahe arab hogaya\nMasjide kufa bhi larazne lagi
english translation text: Within the blessed month, a calamity occurred;\nthe King of Arabia was wounded.\nEven Kufa's mosque began to tremble.

arabic text: Behne laga sar se ali ke lahoo\nGham ki faza phel gayi chaarsu\nParhte the noha ye namazi sabhi
english translation text: Blood began flowing from Ali's head;\nan atmosphere of grief spread everywhere.\nAll the worshippers recited this lament.

arabic text: Waar jo sajde mein ali par huwa\nMola ne bas fuztu woh rabbi kahaa\nKhoob sa’adat yeh ata hogayi
english translation text: When Ali was struck while in prostration,\nthe Maula said only: 'By the Lord of the Kaaba, I have succeeded.'\nWhat great felicity was granted to him.

arabic text: Ghar me khuda ke hi wiladat huwi\nGhar me khuda ke hi shahadat huwi\nGuzri ali haq pe teri zindagi
english translation text: His birth occurred within God's house,\nand his martyrdom too occurred within God's house.\nO Ali, your life passed entirely upon the Truth.

arabic text: Jeena yateemo’n ka huwa hai mahaal\nKaun bhala unka rakhega khayal\nSaare yateemon’ ke hai lab par yehi
english translation text: Life has become unbearable for the orphans.\nWho will now care for them?\nThe same words remain upon every orphan's lips.

arabic text: Chote se abbas bhi rone lage\nNohe kiye zainab o kulsoom ne\nRote hain sar peet ke Hasnain bhi
english translation text: Even young Abbas began to weep.\nZainab and Kulsum recited laments,\nand Hasanayn beat their heads while crying.

arabic text: Hogai Azlaan qayamat bapa\nAati hai zahra ki lahad se sada\nBacho’n ne mere nahi dekhi khushI
english translation text: O Arsalan, Judgement Day has arisen.\nA voice comes from Zahra's grave:\nmy children never witnessed happiness.
